notes: "Here is the format idea in one picture. If you unzip a PowerPoint file, you find that it is already organised by page: presentation.xml, then slide1.xml, slide2.xml and so on, with media, notes and charts as separate parts. The left column comes from this deck's own exported PPTX. PPTD keeps the same idea but leaves the parts open as a working folder: deck.pptd for the order, one .page file per slide, a media folder, and a .huandeng folder for Slide IDs, Story, Sections, Presentations and history. So an agent can open one page file, and nothing forces it to rewrite the whole deck. HUANDENG still exports PPTX when you need to send it. This introduction is one such folder."

designIntent.purpose: PPTX is already organised by part; PPTD keeps the parts as a working folder.
keep: Left column matches this deck's exported PPTX parts
Do not claim PPTX lacks page structure
